scope.purpose: Close whole-book physical-page screening for MM prices, monetary treasure quantities and system tables, then reconcile source findings to the frozen exposed site.
scope.classificationBoundary: This report does not certify full creature profile/stat-block completeness. README.md:85 says MM/MM2 dependency links do not establish a searchable monster catalogue; profile prices are excluded from that current feature surface, not permanently forbidden. System tables and facts consumed by exposed spells are evaluated independently.
scope.moneyDefinition: Costs, fees, wages, market/sale values and monetary treasure contents are economic. Gold-piece-weight capacity is not currency. Descriptive size wording does not establish a price.

method.candidateRule: Any page with one or more configured currency, transaction, valuation, or gem cues is a broad text candidate. This deliberately overincludes treasure tables, XP labels, carrying-weight values, and OCR noise.
method.candidateLimit: Cue status is navigation only. All no-cue pages were visually opened and screened. Food/feeding words alone do not create an economic unit; only direct value, transaction, coin, gem or money-bearing evidence does.
method.pixelReview: The 87 disjoint remainder pages have individual full-page 216 dpi image hashes and were separately viewed one image per result; the prior 27 page-specific full-page reviews are carried forward by exact image SHA. Key findings pages (PDF 7, 12, 54, 62, 69, 84, 92, 101, 102, 105, 106, 113) were individually opened in this pass.
method.pageMapping: PDF ordinal is primary. Visible printed folios are recorded as seen in source page mapping; PDF p.2 title page and art pages p.92/p.105 have only sequence candidates because current images show no footer. Covers are unnumbered.
method.comparison: The 1,000 captured site owners are the product denominator, not source denominator. Numeric coincidence in an unrelated rule/card is not MM fact representation. Exclusions apply only to current feature boundaries.
method.limits: Full-page screen is not line-by-line transcription of profiles or all treasure procedures. No source chip was opened in the site snapshot.
